review.method: Every sheet opened and every crop checked for the right fish, the feature visible at thumbnail size, nothing crossing cell edges and no text artifacts; a labelled contact image of all 134 new crops was reviewed (workspace/.openclaw/tmp/fhl-split/new-crops.jpg).

alternatesChosen.angelfish-patch: first take (brown discus) showed no visible patch; alternate black angelfish has a clear saddle.
alternatesChosen.angelfish-hole-in-head: alternate pigeon-blood discus shows the pits more clearly.
alternatesChosen.african-malawi-bloat: alternate yellow lab has a clearly swollen belly as well as the stringy droppings.

repairs: split-repair: velvet dust had been drawn on naturally gold/yellow fish (honey gourami, golden angelfish, olive rosy barb, yellow-blue African) and read as the fish's own colour - redrawn on dark/blue fish (gourami, barb, angelfish, african dust used); molly 'shimmies' cell was an eel-like body (black molly retake used); barb injury notch too subtle (rosy barb retake used); African balance tilt read as normal swimming (upside-down retake used). Its pleco dropsy takes still drew a separate ball - not used.

split-repair-2: pleco dropsy redrawn in several framings; the common pleco on the glass with a swollen belly (cell 12) used. Its molly-balance and pleco-flukes retakes were no better than the first takes - not used.

weakCells.pleco-dropsy: belly is exaggerated and balloon-like, but clearly part of the fish and clearly bloated.
weakCells.pleco-flukes: pleco is slightly motion-blurred against driftwood; reads as darting/rubbing.
weakCells.molly-balance: black molly hangs tilted near the surface rather than lying on its side.
weakCells.african-dust: gold dust on the dark blue cichlid is visible but subtle (velvet is subtle by nature; caption says to shine a torch).
weakCells.guppy-eyes / guppy-cloudy-eye: both close-ups show a pale eye; the popeye one bulges, the cloudy one does not.
weakCells.gourami-breathing: a reddish area near the gill of the gasping honey gourami.

notGenerated.guppy Camallanus worms: optional; no Camallanus condition exists in the guide, so it is a guppy tip on Bloat instead of a picture.

review.noPictureByDesign: guppy, molly, barb, gourami, cory and pleco have no hole-in-the-head picture (a cichlid problem); those results fall back to the generic picture. Saltwater fish types have selector tiles only; their results use the generic marine pictures.
review.duplicateSubmission: livebearer-split-2-r2 was an unneeded duplicate (agent misread an in-flight run as terminated); the original livebearer-split-2 is used, r2 retained unused.
